name: Amara
source:
Amara is the child of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c165735]Baronet Gwendolen[/url]. Tragically killed in the womb, Amara thrives in the afterlife with her mother. [url=https://vndb.org/c165588]The Divine[/url] allowed the MC and Amara to meet supernaturally.
